metadata.name: kryon_perps
metadata.description: Kryon tokenized-stock perps: settlement, margin and risk on Solana.

fields.name: admin
docs: Squads vault on mainnet. Everything admin-only checks this key.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Set by `nominate_admin`, cleared by `accept_admin`. Default = none.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Hot key that can only pause.

fields.name: operators
docs: Matcher keys allowed to call `settle_fills`. Default = empty slot.

fields.name: calendar_authority
docs: Keeper key that posts session windows.

fields.name: insurance
docs: `Insurance` PDA, set by `init_insurance`. Default until then.

fields.name: domain
docs: cannot read the genesis hash). Bound into every signed order.

fields.name: max_total_oi_policy_bps
docs: Ceiling on the sum of every market's `oi_policy_bps` (`11` L11).

fields.name: settlement_mint
docs: Mint of the settlement collateral (USDC). Default until added.

fields.name: settlement_collateral_index
docs: `Collateral.index` of the settlement asset (valid once it is added).

fields.name: collateral_count
docs: Collaterals added so far; the next one gets this index.

fields.name: max_reward_bps
docs: Liquidator reward cap, bps of closed notional (≤ 10%, `05` §2). Set
with the insurance fund; zero means liquidation is not live yet.

fields.name: partial_liquidation_bps
docs: Share of a position one liquidation step may close (`plan_liquidation`).
